name: io.github.laffeyp/cascade-img
title: cascade-img
description: LLM-operable Midjourney pipeline: 21 MCP tools to compose, generate, curate with vision, and log.

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_USER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Discord user-account token the bridge daemon uses to talk to Midjourney (captured from the Discord desktop app; see RUNBOOK.md).

environmentVariables.name: MJ_CHANNEL_ID
environmentVariables.description: Discord channel ID where the Midjourney bot runs.

environmentVariables.name: MJ_IMAGINE_VERSION
environmentVariables.description: Version token for Midjourney's /imagine slash command, captured from Discord.

environmentVariables.name: CASCADE_BRIDGE_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL of the running cascade-mj-bridge daemon that cascade-mcp forwards to.
